div.ab: Gyf he ne mæge, þonne wille ic, mid uncer begra cræfte þæt he hine on earde adwæsce oððe ut of earde adræfe, sy he betera sy he wyrsa.

Gyf he ne mæge, þonne wille ic, mid uncer begra cræfte þæt he hine on earde adwæsce oððe ut of earde adræfe, sy he betera sy he wyrsa.
Wenn er [es] nicht vermag, dann wünsch ich, dass er mit unser beider Macht ihn im Lande vertilge oder ausser Landes vertreibe, sei derselbe vornehmer oder niedriger.
If he cannot, then I wish that with the power of us both he destroy him in the land or drive him out of the land, whether he be of higher or lower rank.

If he cannot, it is my will that he should make use of both his own resources and mine for the purpose of driving him out of the country or crushing him, if he remains in the country, whether he be of high or humble station.
If he cannot, then it is my will that with the power of us both he shall destroy him in the land or drive him out of the land, whether he be of high or low rank.
If he cannot, then I desire him to wipe him from the earth or drive him from the land with our combined strength, whether he is of higher or lower status.
